recognize_zh: 這是 HTLV-1 抗體西方墨點法（Western blot）圖，非形態學影像：移植前（0 個月）可見 rgp46、p36、p32、p28、p24、p19、p21E 多條強帶，骨髓移植後各帶逐漸變淡，僅 p19 與 rgp46 持續存在，反映抗病毒抗體下降。
features: HTLV-1 Western blot strips with positive (P) and negative (N) controls
Month 0 (pre-BMT) strip shows strong bands for env (rgp46, p21E) and gag (p19, p24, p28, p32, p36) proteins
Post-BMT strips (5, 7, 17, 26, 38 months) show progressive fading of gag bands, with loss of p24, p21E, and most p28-p36 bands
p19 and rgp46 bands persist through 38 months
Negative control shows no bands, confirming assay specificity
describe_en: This figure is a Western blot for anti-HTLV-1 antibodies in serial sera from a patient with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma before and after allogeneic bone marrow transplantation. The pre-transplant (month 0) sample shows strong reactivity to env (rgp46, p21E) and multiple gag proteins (p19, p24, p28, p32, p36), exceeding the positive control. After transplantation, band intensity decreases progressively, with persistence mainly of p19 and rgp46 up to 38 months. The pattern indicates a decline of the anti-HTLV-1 antibody response after BMT, interpreted as reduction of HTLV-1-infected cell burden; this is serologic data and does not provide morphologic information.
